Name: Persona 4 Yosuke to replace Sam
Author: loadedspag
Description:
***I WILL BE UPDATING THIS MOD!! Just expect a couple months to go through the update and redo/add portraits and sprites! (3/31/24)***


This mod replaces Sam with Yosuke from Persona 4- because we deserve to romance him somewhere!

[b]Installation[/b]
Download SMAPI and Content Patcher.
Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
Run the game using SMAPI.


[b]Notes[/b]
Sprites and portraits are redone; story is largely the same with some minor dialogue touches. The most major dialogue change is the Summit event, which incorporates a light mix of Yosuke's P4G Rank 10/3rd Tier dialogue. Feel free to use these assets elsewhere, but please credit when appropriate.

Used in conjunction with an NPC renaming mod- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4251]like so[/url]. Changed Sam to Yosuke, and I also changed Vincent to Teddie but whatever suits you. However, there was some dialog missing that I replaced to the best of my ability, but a few gaps still remain (please ignore Sam's Boombox, for instance).


This is my very first (and lbh probably will remain only) mod I've ever made, so apologies in advance for anything wonky. Don't expect this to be updated frequently.
[size=1]Please be nice to him :(
